title: Intelligence Brief
headline: A day after Anthropic disclosed Scion, Facebook Mononoke's creator argues Scion reuses Mononoke's
subtitle: A day after Anthropic disclosed Scion, Facebook, Paramount Skydance completed its $110.9 billion, Cybersecurity experts interviewed by CSO Online

heroStat.label: Paramount Skydance's Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition, closed Oct 6 — missed by two prior weekly discovery passes

insights.text: A day after Anthropic disclosed Scion, Facebook Mononoke's creator argues Scion reuses Mononoke's 2017-18 "derived data" technique and that Anthropic credited Sapling instead of the closer precedent. No dispute that Scion solves a real problem at Anthropic's scale — the claim is that the underlying technique predates the agent-coding wave by about a decade.

Paramount Skydance completed its $110.9 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery on October 6, 2026, at $31/share; the combined company was renamed Skydance Corporation. This research's own Thursday OTT discovery searches on Oct 1 and Oct 8 both reported no October news on either tracked merger, missing the close entirely.

Cybersecurity experts interviewed by CSO Online reject the "rogue AI" framing for 2026's agent-hacking incidents, naming skipped containment basics (sandboxing, egress controls) at OpenAI and Anthropic as the real cause. The same day, three pre-existing GitHub repos for auditing or pentesting AI agents (K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills, ifixai-ai/iFixAi, vxcontrol/pentagi) all climbed GitHub Trending.

Figma announced Specs, a markdown editor for design-language rules agents read while working, and took Code Layers (canvas-embedded code) into public beta. Figma's Chief Design Officer reports 17x more generated code against only 1.3x more releases since opening agent access — mostly exploration code, by the company's own framing.

morluto/rea leads GitHub Trending for a tenth consecutive day. Direct API fetch shows 248,932 stars, 62,487 forks, 815 open issues; forks outpacing stars extends to a sixth consecutive capture even as the raw growth rate keeps decelerating (+15.2% stars today vs. +27.2% yesterday).

Claude by Anthropic climbs to #7 in today's Play Store capture, a fourth consecutive capture in the same direction (#22 to #13 to #9 to #7) — the longest same-direction run this research has logged for one app, though the single-snapshot chart method still cannot rule out noise.

debpalash/VoiceStudio, a fully-local open-source ElevenLabs alternative for voice cloning, climbs from #3 to #2 on GitHub Trending (66,971 total stars, up from 63,955) on its second consecutive strong trending day.

browser-use shipped macos-harness v0.2.1, a dedicated macOS agent-isolation product — a second concrete instance of the "give the agent its own OS account" pattern this research flagged on Oct 9 via the solo-maintainer tool offstage.

takeaway.text: A credit dispute over Anthropic's new source-control system and a merger that already closed without this research noticing both argue for the same lesson: verify dated claims against primary sources, not just the news cycle that surfaced them.
